input.contract: Treat dict insertion order as LRU-to-MRU. capacity must be a positive integer excluding bool; raise ValueError for zero, negative, bool, or non-integer capacity, without mutating entries. Return a fresh dict and never mutate entries. Updating or inserting key makes it MRU; repeatedly evict the LRU entry while the length exceeds capacity.
